title: austroblechnum durum
intro: Austroblechnum durum, commonly known as the New Zealand fan fern, is a species of fern in the family Blechnaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Austroblechnum durum include its use as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent, as well as its potential in treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
